objective: promote all seven lanes only through positive cost-adjusted independent evidence; never force a weak lane into core

keltner_holygrail_30m.rule: preserve 4.5 ATR/cost gate and RR geometry; fresh child only
keltner_holygrail_30m.promotion_gate: fresh positive Net/PF with no LS/DD regression

trend_rider_coherent_stale_scratch.rule: use as 1x/0.5x/0.25x risk state, not outcome-selected trade deletion
trend_rider_coherent_stale_scratch.promotion_gate: fresh causal reduction of cluster loss while preserving edge density

break_trend_dispered.rule: no long/short cherry-pick; one structural continuation axis
break_trend_dispered.promotion_gate: both development and fresh windows positive; winner concentration reduced

supertrend_regime.rule: do not open another axis before existing fresh25 contracts resolve
supertrend_regime.promotion_gate: fresh25 plus concentration hardening and no payoff/PF regression

squeeze_break.rule: PANIC long child fixed; change lifecycle only
squeeze_break.promotion_gate: fresh Net/PF improvement without increased false-release DD

cross_sectional_mean_reversion_v1.rule: formation window chooses pair; trading window cannot retune pair; realistic two-leg costs
cross_sectional_mean_reversion_v1.promotion_gate: NetExp>=8bps/T, PF>=1.25, positive fresh period, T/day>=0.5

micro_exhaustion_edge.rule: do not retune frozen EDGE until fresh trades exist; new OFI child is separate identity; passive fill model required before live
micro_exhaustion_edge.promotion_gate: fresh sample, positive after-cost economics, execution-fidelity pass

global_core_gate: low enough correlation to existing core to add portfolio value
